_about: Merged by scripts/package.py into Adventure's world/items.json (add / modify / remove by name).

add.name: Writ of Passage
add.description: A council writ that opens the Crossroads' north gate to the Plains of Serra.

add.name: Choice: Relic
add.description: Choose one of three relics for your Trinket slot.

add.name: Choice: Castle Relic
add.description: Choose one of three castle relics for your Relic slot.

add.name: Choice: Power 9
add.description: Choose one of the Power 9 you do not own yet.

add.name: Oathstone of the Walkers
add.description: Castle relic. At the beginning of your first upkeep, conjure a random planeswalker card from the Oathstone's spellbook onto the battlefield.

add.name: Crown of the Five Castles
add.description: Castle relic. Add one mana of any color. Activate only once each turn.

add.name: Bell of Wishes
add.description: Castle relic. Put a card you own from your sideboard into your hand, then exile Bell of Wishes. Activate only as a sorcery.

add.name: Whetstone of Ages
add.description: Castle relic. Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to an opponent, it perpetually gets +1/+0.

add.name: Standard of the Vanguard
add.description: Castle relic. Whenever you cast a creature spell, that spell perpetually gets +1/+0 and gains vigilance.

add.name: Chalice of Dawn
add.description: Castle relic. At the beginning of your upkeep, you gain 1 life. Whenever you gain life for the first time each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.

add.name: Tidecaller's Codex
add.description: Castle relic. Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, draw a card. You have no maximum hand size.

add.name: Astrolabe of First Light
add.description: Castle relic. At the beginning of your first upkeep, draw two cards. At the beginning of your upkeep, scry 1.

add.name: Phylactery of the Undying
add.description: Castle relic. If you would lose the game, instead exile Phylactery of the Undying and your life total becomes 7.

add.name: Grimoire of the First Tutor
add.description: Castle relic. At the beginning of your first upkeep, search your library for a card, put it into your hand, then shuffle. You lose 2 life.

add.name: Lantern of the Lich-Lord
add.description: Castle relic. Whenever a creature you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

add.name: Emberheart Brand
add.description: Castle relic. If a source you control would deal noncombat damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, it deals that much damage plus 1 instead.

add.name: Sigil of the Storm
add.description: Castle relic. Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, Sigil of the Storm deals 2 damage to each opponent.

add.name: Heart of the Wildwood
add.description: Castle relic. Creatures you control enter with an additional +1/+1 counter on them.

add.name: Gaea's Hearthstone
add.description: Castle relic. You may play an additional land on each of your turns. Whenever a land you control enters, you gain 1 life.

add.name: Explorer's Charm
add.description: Relic. You may play an additional land on each of your turns.

add.name: Scrying Lens
add.description: Relic. At the beginning of your upkeep, scry 1.

add.name: Seeker's Map
add.description: Relic. At the beginning of your first upkeep, put a random land card from your library into your hand.

add.name: Tutor's Satchel
add.description: Relic. At the beginning of your first upkeep, look at the top four cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

add.name: Wishing Coin
add.description: Relic. Put a card you own from your sideboard into your hand, then exile Wishing Coin. Activate only as a sorcery.

add.name: Charm of the Gatewatch
add.description: Relic. At the beginning of your first upkeep, conjure a random planeswalker card from the Oathstone's spellbook into your hand.

add.name: Pilgrim's Flask
add.description: Relic. At the beginning of your upkeep, if you have 10 or less life, you gain 2 life.

add.name: Militia Horn
add.description: Relic. At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control no creatures, create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.

add.name: Quill of Insight
add.description: Relic. Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, scry 1.

add.name: Pearl of the Deep
add.description: Relic. At the beginning of your end step, if you have no cards in hand, draw a card.

add.name: Gravecaller's Coin
add.description: Relic. Whenever a nontoken creature you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life.

add.name: Vial of Ichor
add.description: Relic. Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, you gain 1 life.

add.name: Kindling Charm
add.description: Relic. Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, Kindling Charm deals 1 damage to each opponent. This ability triggers only once each turn.

add.name: Spark of the Forge
add.description: Relic. At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn.

add.name: Hunter's Fang
add.description: Relic. Creatures you control with power 4 or greater have trample.

add.name: Whistle of the Pack
add.description: Relic. At the beginning of your first upkeep, create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token.

add.name: Heart of the Shards
add.description: Planar relic. Multicolored spells you cast cost {1} less. Whenever you cast a multicolored spell, scry 1.

add.name: Lantern of the Kami
add.description: Planar relic. Legendary spells you cast cost {1} less. Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, create a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token.

add.name: Ichor of the Mother
add.description: Planar relic. Creatures you control have toxic 1. At the beginning of your end step, proliferate.

Blue rune.description: The way to the island lands is closed for now.

Black rune.description: The way to the swamp lands is closed for now.

Red rune.description: The way to the mountain lands is closed for now.

Green rune.description: The way to the forest lands is closed for now.

Blue Staff.description: Doubles your speed for some time (flight would skip the region gates)
